 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 5 12 Nov 2026 - 14:45 Stadion Pod Goricom Montenegro host Latvia at Stadion Pod Goricom in Podgorica in a UEFA Nations League C group fixture, with both sides in contrasting form heading into the match.
 Mirko Vucinic's Montenegro side sit top of Group 2 and have been in solid form across the Nations League campaign, picking up wins over Latvia and Armenia in recent weeks. Their only dropped points came in a goalless draw with Armenia on October 5.
 Latvia arrive in far less convincing shape. Paolo Nicolato's side have lost their last four matches, including a 2-1 defeat to Montenegro in the reverse fixture on October 2 and a 2-1 loss to Cyprus on October 5.
 Montenegro have scored freely in this Nations League cycle, finding the net in every match they have played in the competition. Latvia, by contrast, have struggled to keep pace at the back and have been shut out twice in their last four outings.
 The head-to-head record between these sides leans in Montenegro's favour, and the home side will be looking to press their advantage at the top of the table with another win on home soil.
